author: Dom H
name: rate_group
description: Provides keyboard shortcuts to apply a star rating or rejection to every image in a group at once.
description-extensive: This tool lets you rate or reject an entire group of photos with a single keyboard shortcut instead of doing each one individually. It is especially useful for people who shoot RAW+JPEG pairs and use a star-rating workflow, since the rating gets applied to all images in the stack together. No extra software is needed.
